name: Barbell Clean and Press
summary: A full-body explosive movement where a barbell is cleaned from the floor to the shoulders and pressed overhead to full lockout.

setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the barbell over your midfoot.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs with a pronated or hook grip.
Flatten your back, pull your chest up, and pull the slack out of the barbell.
steps: Drive through the floor with your legs to lift the bar smoothly past your knees while keeping your torso angle constant.
Once the bar reaches mid-thigh, explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles while shrugging your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the barbell, whipping your elbows around to catch the bar across the front of your shoulders in a shallow squat.
Stand fully upright, settle your feet to shoulder width, and lower your elbows slightly so the forearms are vertical beneath the bar.
Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and press the bar vertically overhead, moving your head slightly back to clear the chin.
Lock out the elbows with the bar directly over the shoulders and midfoot, pushing your head forward to neutral.
Lower the bar back to the front-rack position under control, then return it to the floor to complete the repetition.
instructions.breathing: Inhale and brace your trunk before pulling from the floor, hold through the catch, take a brief reset breath in the rack, brace before pressing overhead, and exhale at top lockout.
cues: Tuck the chin, press straight up

common_faults.fault: Pulling early with the arms during the clean.
common_faults.correction: Keep the arms straight like ropes until the hips and legs have fully extended.

common_faults.fault: Pressing before establishing a stable, motionless front-rack position.
common_faults.correction: Pause and firmly brace your core and glutes after standing up from the clean before initiating the overhead press.

common_faults.fault: Excessive lumbar hyperextension during the press.
common_faults.correction: Squeeze your glutes and brace your abdominals tightly to maintain a neutral spine as the bar moves overhead.

precautions: Ensure clear floor space and use bumper plates on a lifting platform in case a clean must be dumped forward.
